title: Sermon record v1
description: One recording of one church: where it came from (source, from yt-dlp, never hand-edited), its transcript, what people decided about it (curated, never overwritten by tools), and what tools derived (generated, rewritten on every run). Within major version 1 changes are additive only: a record valid under 1.0 stays valid under every 1.x.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the schema the producer wrote. Readers accept any 1.x up to the minor they know.

id.description: The platform's video id (YouTube id, Vimeo number). Also the transcript's file stem.

church.description: The church's slug, e.g. berean, beacon.

source.description: Copied from the yt-dlp metadata cache. Tools refresh it; people never edit it.

transcript.description: The transcript file, or null when there is none yet.

path.description: Relative to the church's data directory, e.g. transcripts/<id>.txt.

engine.description: parakeet_v3 and wcpp_mc0 passed the yield gate; low_yield is a kept but suspect transcript; failed produced no text. Null when not recorded.

curated.description: Edited by people and never overwritten by tools. A field that is absent or null means 'not curated'; tools fall back to source or generated.

series.description: A series slug; overrides the series rules.

passages.description: Replaces the passages parsed from the title.

published.description: false hides the recording from the site.

duplicate_of.description: Id of the recording this one duplicates (re-upload, second stream); the duplicate is not shown.

generated.description: Derived by tools and rewritten on every run; hand edits are lost.

verses.description: References found in the transcript, first mention first.

t.description: Seconds into the recording of the first mention.

passage.description: One Bible reference such as 'Luke 17:31-37' or '1 John 2'. The pattern checks shape only; sermon_core.record.validate also checks the book exists and the chapter is in range.
